method: R1 blind suread (subagent read text only, no md/rules)

facts.fact: 早晨渐渐过去到了下午，雪先变大后停，留下晶莹的寂静。
facts.anchor: The snow intensifies, then tapers to nothing, leaving behind crystalline stillness.

facts.fact: Hattie 不停查看手机但没有任何消息。
facts.anchor: Hattie continues checking her phone but there’s nothing.

facts.fact: 没有人觉得饿，没有人能坐得住。
facts.anchor: No one is hungry. No one can sit still.

facts.fact: Tommy 说他不会来了，他们不知怎么把他吓跑了。
facts.anchor: He got spooked. We scared him somehow.

facts.fact: Hattie 肯定他还会来，说她从他的声音里听得出来。
facts.anchor: He needs to know. I could hear it in his voice.

facts.fact: Colm 在厨房占据位置，好盯着车道。
facts.anchor: Colm has taken up position in the kitchen so he can see down the driveway.

facts.fact: Colm 猜想他是故意晚来，等天黑后步行进来而不被察觉。
facts.anchor: Maybe he’s waiting for night. Then he can come in on foot without us knowing.

facts.fact: Tommy 说他们占上风：他不知道他们俩都在这儿，也怀疑他不知道 Hattie 有枪。
facts.anchor: But we have the upper hand. He has no idea either of us are here.

facts.fact: Hattie 被猛烈摇醒，是 Colm 在摇她，说有人来了。
